declarations.name: AuiPagination

inputs.name: pageCount
inputs.description: Number of pages. Provide either pageCount or total.

inputs.name: total
inputs.description: Total items; the page count is derived from pageSize. Enables the summary.

inputs.name: pageSizes
inputs.description: Render a native 'Rows per page' select with these sizes.

inputs.name: siblingCount
inputs.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page (0 to 10).

inputs.name: boundaryCount
inputs.description: Pages always shown at the start and end (0 to 10).

inputs.name: showSummary
inputs.description: Show 'Showing 11-20 of 57' when total is known.

models.name: pageSize
models.description: Items per page. Required with total unless pageSizes is set (then defaults to its first entry).

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the page or the page size.

methods.name: setPage
methods.description: Go to a page programmatically (clamped; no events, no announcement).

accessibility.pattern: Navigation landmark of native buttons (no dedicated APG pattern), following common accessible pagination practice: named buttons, aria-current on the current page, disabled bounds, and announced changes.

limitations: No direct page-number input ('go to page').
The compact layout breakpoint (30rem container width) is fixed in the stylesheet.
Changing the page size keeps the first item of the current page visible; consumers wanting page 1 can call setPage(1).
